text: Computer vision is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding where objects are located in an image. Computer vision has many applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to help them see the road, recognise traffic signs, and avoid accidents. It is also used in medicine and security systems. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in the future.
